Canonicalizes that position and transports initial orientation zero. Shifts are explicitly authored record parameters. Index and count must be integral and below 2^24 for the FP32 binding. Portable XIR math need not reproduce host-native N1 initialization bits; no uniform-area or optimal-locality claim. placement_scale is nonnegative; its default is 0.4. Zero deliberately collapses placement to the offset point and is supported for analytical witnesses; it is not a distribution claim.

application_binding.meaning: One composed source-record application. Its actual placement and field symbols determine anchor and intrinsic disk distance, then effective_phase=input.phase+phase_gain*field.distance is supplied to its actual two-Hadamard body symbol. phase_gain is measured in radians per normalized chart-distance unit; radius and shifts are in normalized chart units. The nonzero default phase_gain makes placement and field causally available to the action outputs. Particular symmetric inputs or zero gain can suppress observed sensitivity and must be controlled in experiments. Query orientation and anchor-frame transport are carried as diagnostics; the radial scalar field has sign symmetry. This implements one situated application call, not the complete source cycle, resident mutation, routing or whole-state return.

Strictly smaller squared distance replaces the preceding candidate, preserving the first minimizer. The vertical +0.5 tie maps to -0.5. anchor_frame_y=(-1)^(abs(m) XOR anchor_orientation)*dy is an explicit frame-coordinate diagnostic; the scalar radial field is independent of that sign. The nearest-lift metric follows N1, while the frame diagnostic is an additional declared binding, not a claim of complete tangent covariance.

dependency_policy: Structural numeric and guard dependencies are tracked on linked values, independent of common-subexpression registers. They do not prove nonzero numerical sensitivity; multiplication by zero can retain structural ancestry. Unused callee arguments do not qualify as output dependencies.

global_execution_control.policy: Every instruction executes eagerly in register order until the first failure; any failure zeroes the complete output row and sets lane status. Call arguments execute even when their callee never reads the supplied input. Select operands also execute eagerly.
global_execution_control.qualification: Global execution and failure provenance is distinct from action ancestry. Unrelated guards and unused arguments cannot satisfy the source-slot contribution requirement. A call with no output reaching any returned output or its guards is rejected.

executed_by_this_component: the selected source record's explicit placement, field and body bindings
ordered explicit application calls, guards and named output expressions
retained_but_not_executed: source-model seed and symbol declarations outside explicit bindings
other source operator records and their parameters
not_lowered: whole application cycle and its schedule
dynamic routing and surface transport beyond any explicit bound expressions
lowering.cycle_input: No cycle file is consumed by this situated-Apply compiler.
lowering.application_policy: The application binding defines field and placement influence explicitly; no implicit gate, multiplication or coordinate interpretation is added.
lowering.metadata: Binding source, meaning and status are retained provenance; they are not instructions.

precondition_policy: Each call's requires expressions execute before its outputs; zero fails the lane and finite nonzero satisfies a guard. Guard dependencies are distinguished from numeric output dependencies. All calls and select operands are eagerly evaluated.
numeric_input_policy: Finite constants, parameters and inputs round to IEEE FP32 before execution; negative zero bits are retained. Record index and operator_count must be exactly representable as FP32.
optimization: Identical instruction tuples are shared; no algebraic rewriting or constant folding.

source_input_fp32_rounding.reference: JSON numbers decoded as Python numeric values before packing; compiled_input_rows_fp32 are the execution inputs.

compiler_audit.reason: Final global eager-failure provenance, dead-call rejection and unambiguous call identities; recompiled exact bytes equal executed program.
